import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static List<Integer>[] graph = new ArrayList[2020];
    static int[][] dist_map = new int[20][20], scan = new int[20][20], path_count = new int[20][20];
    static char[][] grid = new char[20][20], pattern = new char[20][20];
    static int[][] dist_grid = new int[20][20];
    static int[] delta_x = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static int[] delta_y = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static List<Integer>[][] node_list = new ArrayList[20][20];
    static List<Integer>[][] node_pattern = new ArrayList[20][20];

    static int[] distance = new int[2020], parent = new int[2020];
    static int total_points, total_paths;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 2020; i++) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                node_list[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                node_pattern[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
    }

    static void connect(int a, int b) {
        graph[a].add(b);
        graph[b].add(a);
    }

    static boolean level_graph(int total_points) {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= total_points; i++) {
            if (parent[i] == 0) {
                distance[i] = 0;
                q.offer(i);
            } else {
                distance[i] = 3010;
            }
        }
        distance[0] = 3010;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            if (distance[u] < distance[0]) {
                for (int v : graph[u]) {
                    int v_parent = parent[v];
                    if (distance[v_parent] > distance[u] + 1) {
                        distance[v_parent] = distance[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(v_parent);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return distance[0] != 3010;
    }

    static boolean find_path(int x) {
        if (x == 0) return true;
        for (int v : graph[x]) {
            int u = parent[v];
            if (distance[u] == distance[x] + 1) {
                if (find_path(u)) {
                    parent[x] = v;
                    parent[v] = x;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int max_matching(int total_points) {
        int matches = 0;
        while (level_graph(total_points)) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= total_points; i++) {
                if (parent[i] == 0)
                    matches += find_path(i) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
        return matches;
    }

    static void process_point(int a, int b, int n, int[][] dist_map, int[][] scan, int[][] dist_grid,
                              List<Integer>[][] node_list, List<Integer>[][] node_pattern) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                dist_grid[i][j] = 100000;
            }
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist_grid[a][b] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{a, b});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] xy = q.poll();
            int x = xy[0], y = xy[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < node_pattern[x][y].size(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < node_list[a][b].size(); j++) {
                    connect(node_list[a][b].get(j), node_pattern[x][y].get(i));
                }
            }
            if (dist_grid[x][y] == dist_map[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + delta_x[d], ny = y + delta_y[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < dist_grid.length && ny < dist_grid[0].length) {
                    if (scan[nx][ny] != -1 && dist_grid[nx][ny] > dist_grid[x][y] + 1 && dist_grid[x][y] + 1 <= dist_map[nx][ny]) {
                        dist_grid[nx][ny] = dist_grid[x][y] + 1;
                        q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                dist_map[i][j] = t;
            }
        }

        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                grid[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                pattern[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        int rx = 0, ry = 0;
        int total_points = 1;
        int total_paths = 1000;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z' || grid[i][j] == 'Y') {
                    scan[i][j] = -1;
                    dist_map[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                    dist_map[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if ('0' <= grid[i][j] && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    scan[i][j] = grid[i][j] - '0';
                } else {
                    scan[i][j] = 0;
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < scan[i][j]; k++) {
                    node_list[i][j].add(total_points++);
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] pattern_count = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if ('0' <= pattern[i][j] && pattern[i][j] <= '9') {
                    pattern_count[i][j] = pattern[i][j] - '0';
                } else {
                    pattern_count[i][j] = 0;
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < pattern_count[i][j]; k++) {
                    node_pattern[i][j].add(total_paths++);
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] dist_map_copy = new int[n + 2][n + 2];
        int[][] scan_copy = new int[n + 2][n + 2];
        int[][] dist_grid_copy = new int[n + 2][n + 2];
        List<Integer>[][] node_list_copy = new ArrayList[n + 2][n + 2];
        List<Integer>[][] node_pattern_copy = new ArrayList[n + 2][n + 2];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                dist_map_copy[i][j] = dist_map[i][j];
                scan_copy[i][j] = scan[i][j];
                dist_grid_copy[i][j] = 0;
                node_list_copy[i][j] = new ArrayList<>(node_list[i][j]);
                node_pattern_copy[i][j] = new ArrayList<>(node_pattern[i][j]);
            }
        }

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{rx, ry});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] xy = q.poll();
            int x = xy[0], y = xy[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + delta_x[d], ny = y + delta_y[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < dist_map.length && ny < dist_map[0].length) {
                    if (dist_map[nx][ny] > dist_map[x][y] + 1 && scan[nx][ny] != -1) {
                        dist_map[nx][ny] = dist_map[x][y] + 1;
                        q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int total_points_final = total_points;
        int total_paths_final = total_paths;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (scan[i][j] > 0) {
                    process_point(i, j, n, dist_map, scan, dist_grid, node_list, node_pattern);
                }
            }
        }

        int result = max_matching(total_points);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
